-221.text: Qin Shi Huang completed the unification of China, founding the Qin Dynasty

-206.text: The Han Dynasty was established after the fall of the Qin

-138.text: Zhang Qian's mission to the west opened the Silk Road trade routes

105.text: Cai Lun improved the papermaking technique during the Han Dynasty

220.text: The Han Dynasty collapsed, beginning the Three Kingdoms period

581.text: Emperor Wen reunified China, founding the Sui Dynasty

618.text: The Tang Dynasty was founded, ushering in a golden age

1279.text: The Mongols under Kublai Khan established the Yuan Dynasty

1368.text: Zhu Yuanzhang founded the Ming Dynasty

1644.text: The Qing Dynasty was established after the fall of the Ming
